character_description: Young adult female in her mid-20s, elegant and melodious voice, graceful pacing with artistic flair, refined and cultured tone, gentle confidence, classical Chinese beauty quality. Studio-quality recording.
audition_line: 艺术品的价值不仅在于材质和年代，更在于它承载的美学意境。这幅铜版画的线条流畅而有力，每一笔都透着大师的气韵，让我再仔细端详一番，一定能发现更多线索。
